title: Container Bookings: Free Allowance for Late Shipping Instructions on a Booking
content:
Some late shipping instructions on a Container Bookings booking are logged free of charge under the product's allowance. This page states how that allowance is counted.

## Rule

The allowance is counted on the booking alone. A late shipping-instruction entry is written at 0.00 when two things hold: the late-document entries already on the same booking are fewer than the product's free late submissions, and the free allowance is open for the booking. In every other case the entry carries the product's late shipping-instruction fee. Late submissions logged on the customer's other bookings are ignored.

## Truth table (hypothetical allowance of 1)

| Late-document entries already on this booking | Allowance open for the booking | Entry written at |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | yes | 0.00 |
| 1 | yes | the late SI fee |
| 0 | no | the late SI fee |
| 0, with three late entries on the customer's other bookings | yes | 0.00 |

The allowance of 1 is illustrative. Whether the allowance is open depends on the booking's cargo category and, for dangerous goods, on its acceptances.
